purpose: Candidate offline/open-source components for future Friends to Amigos writing diagnosis and feedback. Read WRITING_ENGINE.md before integrating any dependency.

resources.name: ehoogerbeets/conjugator
resources.notes: TypeScript/JavaScript. Defaults to castillano and supports Spain tú/vosotros plus regional styles. Use as a diagnostic helper, not a whole-sentence grader.
resources.shippingGate: Preserve Apache-2.0 notices and confirm WebView/bundle compatibility.

resources.name: wooorm/nspell
resources.notes: Plain JavaScript Hunspell-compatible checker. Suggestions are diagnostic evidence, not proof that a learner answer is wrong.
resources.shippingGate: Requires a separately licensed Spanish dictionary.

resources.name: wooorm/dictionaries: dictionary-es
resources.notes: The dictionary/affix data retain their own licence; the monorepo packaging being MIT does not replace it. Source locale is es_ES.
resources.shippingGate: Explicitly choose a permitted licence path and satisfy its redistribution/source/notice obligations before bundling.

resources.name: Friends to Amigos learner-error rule bank
resources.notes: Highest-priority approach. Rules should target taught misconceptions such as tener for age/hunger, ser/estar, gustar, agreement, contractions and wrong verb person.
resources.shippingGate: Require deterministic tests and low false-rejection rate.

resources.name: axa-group/nlp.js
resources.notes: Use only after deterministic grading is strong. Intent recognition can show that meaning was communicated but must never by itself prove grammatical correctness.
resources.shippingGate: Train on original or properly licensed examples; measure false accepts/rejects before scored use.

resources.name: LanguageTool
resources.notes: Mature pattern-based grammar checker, but the Java/JVM engine is much heavier than the current offline WebView architecture. Prefer learning from its rule approach rather than embedding the full engine.
resources.shippingGate: Separate architecture and licence review required before any embedded reuse of code/rules.

resources.name: apertium/apertium-spa
resources.notes: Powerful linguistic resource but heavier and less natural for the current JavaScript/WebView product than the preferred options.
resources.shippingGate: Do not embed without deliberate GPL and architecture review.

futureWritingModes.controlled: Can use deterministic correct/incorrect scoring when the task has a narrow target.
futureWritingModes.guided: Support multiple valid formulations; use correct/acceptable/needs-fix/uncertain/off-task states rather than brittle exact matching.
futureWritingModes.free: Offer high-confidence coaching and model answers; do not claim authoritative essay grading.
